steps.help: The chain of process steps from left to right; each step with title, description, value type, inputs, outputs, sub-steps and at most one loop.

title.help: The title of the step, a short name of the activity.

description.help: The description of the step, free text.

valueType.help: The value type of the step: value-adding (VA), business non-value-adding (BNVA) or non-value-adding (NVA); without one the step is unclassified.

va.help: Value-adding (VA): the step creates direct customer value.

bnva.help: Business non-value-adding (BNVA): operationally necessary, but no customer value.

nva.help: Non-value-adding (NVA): waste, a candidate for elimination.

inputs.help: The inputs of the step in order, each with a name and an input type.

inputType.help: The input type: process parameter (x) or noise factor (n); without one the input is unclassified.

param.help: Process parameter (x): a controllable input, such as a machine setting.

noise.help: Noise factor (n): an input that is hard or impossible to control, such as the ambient temperature.

outputs.help: The outputs of the step in order, each with a name.

substeps.help: The sub-steps (detail steps) of the step in order.

loop.help: The loop of the step: a return to an earlier step with a condition and rework steps; without it the step has no loop.

targetStepId.help: The earlier step the loop returns to; without one the band stays open at its step.

condition.help: The condition that triggers the loop.

steps.help: The rework steps that only run on the return path, in order.

title.help: The title of the rework step.

expanded.help: The steps whose sub-steps are expanded; display only, the content stays.

addStep.help: Inserts an empty step into the chain and returns its id.

params.command: The command as an object, optionally with atIndex.
params.atIndex: Position of the new step after inserting (0 = the very front, the number of steps = at the end). Without it the step is appended. A value outside that range or a non-integer is an error.

removeStep.help: Removes a step from the chain. Every loop that returns to it is removed entirely.

params.command: The command as an object with id.
params.id: The id of the step to remove. An unknown id is an error.

moveStep.help: Moves a step to another position in the chain. A loop target that then no longer lies before its step is cleared.

params.command: The command as an object with id and index.
params.id: The id of the step to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.index: The position of the step after the move, a whole number from 0 (the very front) to the number of steps minus one.

appendSteps.help: Appends several steps to the end of the chain, for example from the process column of a SIPOC. Returns the number of appended steps.

params.command: The command as an object with steps.
params.steps: The steps to append as a list; each entry has a title.

cycleValueType.help: Cycles the value type of a step: unclassified → value-adding (VA) → business non-value-adding (BNVA) → non-value-adding (NVA) → unclassified.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.

addIO.help: Appends an empty input or output to a step and returns its id.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and type.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.type: The list: 'inputs' or 'outputs'. Any other value is an error.

removeIO.help: Removes an input or output from a step.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId, type and ioId.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.type: The list: 'inputs' or 'outputs'. Any other value is an error.
params.ioId: The id of the entry in that list. An unknown id is an error.

moveIO.help: Moves an input or output within its list to the position of another entry of the same list.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId, type, ioId and targetIoId.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.ioId: The id of the entry to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.targetIoId: The id of the entry whose position it takes; a different entry of the same list. An unknown id is an error.

cycleInputType.help: Cycles the type of an input: no type → process parameter (x) → noise factor (n) → no type.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and ioId.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.ioId: The id of the input. An unknown id or the id of an output is an error.

addSubstep.help: Adds an empty sub-step to a step and returns its id.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step that gets the new sub-step. An unknown id is an error.

removeSubstep.help: Removes a sub-step. A step left without sub-steps collapses.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and substepId.
params.stepId: The id of the parent step. An unknown id is an error.
params.substepId: The id of the sub-step to remove. An unknown id is an error.

moveSubstep.help: Moves a sub-step to another position within its step.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId, substepId and index.
params.stepId: The id of the step the sub-step belongs to. An unknown id is an error.
params.substepId: The id of the sub-step to move. An unknown id is an error.
params.index: The position of the sub-step after the move, a whole number from 0 (the very front) to the number of sub-steps minus one.

setExpanded.help: Shows or hides the sub-steps of a step; display only, the content stays.

params.command: The command as an object with id and expanded.
params.id: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.expanded: true shows the sub-steps, false hides them.

setLoop.help: Creates or removes the loop of a step. A new loop is empty, without condition, target or rework steps; removing one takes these with it.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and on.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.
params.on: true creates the loop (an existing one stays), false removes it.

removeLoop.help: Removes the loop of a step with its condition, target and rework steps.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step. An unknown id is an error.

setLoopTarget.help: Chooses the earlier step the loop returns to; without a target the band stays open.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and targetStepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step with the loop. A step without a loop is rejected.
params.targetStepId: The id of a step before this step; empty clears the target. An unknown id is an error, an id that does not lie before it is rejected.

addLoopStep.help: Appends an empty rework step to the loop of a step and returns its id.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step with the loop. A step without a loop is rejected.

removeLoopStep.help: Removes a rework step from the loop of a step.

params.command: The command as an object with stepId and loopStepId.
params.stepId: The id of the step with the loop. A step without a loop is rejected.
params.loopStepId: The id of the rework step. An unknown id is an error.
